Answer: Compile-time polymorphism through method overloading and runtime polymorphism
through method overriding.

English: Overloading uses the same method name with different parameter lists. Overriding replaces
an inherited instance method implementation.
සිංහල: Overloading කියන්Jන් එකම method name එකට Jවනස් parameters දීම. Overriding කියන්Jන් parent method එක child class එJකේ නැවත implement කිරීම.
Real-world example: A calculator adds two or three numbers; a dog changes Animal.sound().

Result / explanation: new Calculator().add(2, 3) returns 5; add(2, 3, 4) returns 9. new Dog().sound()
prints Bark.

Overloading Overriding · Different parameter lists Same signature; compatible return type · Inheritance not required Requires inherited instance method · Compile-time selection Runtime dispatch · Return type alone insufficient Cannot override final methods; static methods are hidden
Interview question: Can methods be overloaded by changing only the return type?
Answer: No. Java requires distinct parameter lists for overloading.
Remember: Overload = Different inputs. Override = Different implementation.
